Name: Simple greenhouse 15x15

Description:
1. a 15 * 15 normal planting area
2. 12 fruit tree planting areas
3. arbitrary plant planting area
4. palisade plant planting area

There are two "content.json" files in this compressed package.
--> content.json
--> content_2.json

1. content.json:  This file fixes the problem of misaligned greenhouse entrance coordinates, but it uses the original farm. If you use a custom farm mod, do not use it.

2. content_2.json: This document will have a problem with the entrance coordinates of the greenhouse. It can be compatible with any other farm mod.

You rename the two files according to your own situation.
